valuation.ev_ebit_withheld_reason: Withheld: EBIT and net debt are not both on file for FY2023, so EV/EBIT cannot be built. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.note: P/E stands on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file; the statement and the ratios above are H1 2026, an interim and not annualised.
valuation.basis: current market cap vs the annual period both statements cover
valuation.pePeriodNote: P/E and the income multiples stand on FY2025, the newest annual earnings on file, not on H1 2026, the newest period on file, which is an interim and is not annualised
valuation.peRouteNote: the two P/E routes differ (market cap over net profit 53.45, price over EPS 50.00); the net-profit row reconciles with the filing's own profit before tax less tax, so the EPS row is the one filed in a different unit
